title: Pipe Filters
subtitle: Sort what goes where
text:
Use a Pipe Filter on an input end of an item or fluid pipe to fit it. Right click the filter with an empty hand to set it up: put items in the 9 slots as a pattern.

Allow: the end takes only what is listed, and gets it first.
Deny: the end takes anything not listed.
Tags: match by item tag instead of the exact item.
Data: also match names, enchantments and other data.
caption: Allow ends first, then the rest

steps.note:
Crafting Table
2x Iron Sheet, 2x Iron Bars, 1x Control Board

steps.text: Items go to matching Allow ends in turn. Only when none of them can take more do they go to plain ends and Deny ends that do not list them.
Breaking the pipe or changing the end with the screwdriver drops the filter with its settings kept.
